"To be able to address complex issues and dependencies in the area of sustainability, this data must be compiled and linked on a suitable data platform in interdisciplinary collaboration." An innovative data lake based on Microsoft Fabric provides Schaeffler with a consistent, standardized, and consolidated view of sustainability in its products.

To achieve this, Schaeffler has developed a central platform based on Microsoft Cloud for Sustainability and Microsoft Sustainability Manager Thanks to Microsoft Fabric, we'll be able to answer lots of questions about climate neutrality and decarbonization company-wide via a single platform-and we can implement new use cases for our colleagues in short sprints within two to six weeks.
